captions.detailed: A variable ND (neutral density) camera filter adapter with a round, low-profile design. It consists of a fixed rear threaded collar in matte black, a central dark-tinted semi-transparent glass filter element, and a rotating outer density adjustment ring. The outer ring rotates continuously around the central optical axis to vary the light transmission.
captions.instruction: Create a variable ND filter adapter with a fixed rear adapter collar, a central glass filter, and a continuously rotating outer adjustment ring. Apply a dark matte black material to the metal rings and a semi-transparent dark tint to the glass element.
captions.factory: Construct the fixed base thread collar and the rotating outer ring using concentric cylinder primitives subtracted from one another to form thin-walled rings. Model the glass filter as a thin cylindrical plate positioned in the center. Define a continuous rotational joint between the fixed base collar and the outer ring along the central Z-axis.
